text: レッドは　あなぬけのヒモを　つかって　＊を　だっしゅつした！

structure.jp: あなぬけのヒモを　つかって

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て shape joins two actions, the first leading into the second. つかって = 'used it and'.

patterns.name: 〜を (leaving)
patterns.explanation: を with a verb of leaving shows the place you get out of, not something you act on. ＊を　だっしゅつした = 'escaped from ＊'.
